items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 37:1
items.html: The Mochin that were corrected by the first two divisions remain permanently corrected and never depart again, and the actions of the lower ones do not reach them. However, the Mochin that come from the MAN of the third division, since they come from below upward — meaning that the lower ones must raise this MAN — are therefore also reached by a flaw from the lower ones, and these Mochin are not permanent, but rise and fall according to the actions of the lower ones. (page 625, Sub Header, “The Choicest”)
